item.title: 'India stands in solidarity': PM Modi speaks to UAE prez, condemns attacks by Iran
Middle East tensions surge: Saudi Arabia summons Iran envoy in escalating Gulf crisis amid US-Israel attacks
item.description: Saudi Arabia has summoned Iran's ambassador. This action follows Iranian attacks on Saudi territory and neighbouring Gulf states. The move escalates tensions linked to the ongoing US-Israel conflict with Iran. Other Gulf nations like Kuwait and Qatar have also protested Iranian actions. Saudi Arabia vows to defend its sovereignty and security.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 4,000-year-old 36 swords seized at a US port in Philadelphia in a bizarre smuggling case
item.description: US Customs and Border Protection seized 36 Bronze Age short swords and 50 arrowheads, nearly 4,000 years old, at the Port of Philadelphia. The ancient Iranian artifacts were misdeclared as 'metal decorations' and routed through multiple countries, likely destined for the illicit antiquities market. Archaeologists confirmed their authenticity and cultural heritage value.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: GCC's largest container port Jebel Ali hit amid Iran-US-Israel war? DP World responds as Epstein scandal haunts its Dubai operations
item.description: Dubai's Jebel Ali Port, a global trade linchpin, has temporarily ceased operations following a fire caused by aerial debris amidst escalating US-Israel conflict with Iran. This precautionary shutdown highlights the widening regional instability, impacting vital supply chains and underscoring the vulnerability of critical infrastructure. The incident adds to DP World's recent corporate scrutiny after Epstein Files controversy.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Refunds, free hotels, rebooking, food provisions for tourists stuck in UAE
item.description: Air travel in the Middle East is severely disrupted as the US-Israel war on Iran leads to extensive flight cancellations and airspace closures. Major UAE carriers have suspended operations, stranding thousands of tourists. Authorities are providing support, including accommodation and meals, while advising passengers to check flight statuses and know their rights.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: US–Israel war on Iran: Dos and don’ts for UAE residents amid high alert
item.description: As the US and Israel's military campaign against Iran escalates, the UAE implements broad public safety measures. Residents are urged to comply with official instructions, seek shelter during alerts, and avoid spreading unverified information, which carries legal penalties. Educational institutions have shifted to distance learning, and travel disruptions persist due to airspace closures.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE stock markets close, trading halted by Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange and the Dubai Financial Market for two days amid Iran–US–Israel war fallout
item.description: The UAE has shut its Dubai and Abu Dhabi stock markets for two days, March 2-3, 2026, due to escalating Iran-US-Israel conflict fallout. This unprecedented move follows Iranian retaliatory strikes, disrupting regional business and investor confidence. Other Gulf markets saw sharp declines, with oil prices surging amid fears of supply disruptions.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Bombing a country won’t make the Epstein files go away,' Rep. Thomas Massie warns after US-Israel launch strike on Iran
item.description: Representative Thomas Massie criticizes President Trump's military actions in Iran, suggesting they are intended to distract from the release of Jeffrey Epstein documents. Massie, who co-sponsored legislation to declassify Epstein files, argues that such foreign policy maneuvers do not negate the need for transparency.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Is Sahara Desert dust secretly feeding the Amazon? The science behind a 10,000-mile journey
item.description: In 2015, NASA-backed research led by Hongbin Yu revealed that millions of tons of Saharan dust cross the Atlantic each year, delivering vital phosphorus to the nutrient-poor Amazon rainforest. Satellite data showed this atmospheric link may replenish nutrients lost to rainfall, highlighting a vast intercontinental exchange that underscores how climate and ecosystems remain deeply interconnected.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Texas bar shooting: Suspect wore ‘Property of Allah’ hoodie, undershirt referring to Iran and had a Quran in his car — what we know about Ndiaga Diagne
item.description: An ex-New York resident, identified as Ndiaga Diagne, is suspected of carrying out a deadly shooting at a Texas bar. Law enforcement sources suggest a possible motive of vengeance related to US actions in Iran, citing a "Property of Allah" hoodie and an Iranian flag symbol.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE airspace chaos: Sharjah Airport issues passenger advisory amid US-Israel war on Iran, flight disruptions
item.description: Sharjah International Airport is experiencing significant flight disruptions, including cancellations and delays, due to temporary UAE airspace closures. These measures are a direct response to escalating US-Israel military actions against Iran and subsequent regional security concerns. Passengers are strongly advised to verify flight statuses with airlines before traveling to avoid unnecessary inconvenience.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'They want to talk, and I agreed': Trump claims Iran seeking dialogue
item.description: President Trump stated in an interview that Iran's new leadership wants to talk, and he has agreed to discussions. He expressed confidence in an upcoming uprising, noting celebrations among Iranians and expatriates. Trump also indicated he would assess support for any potential uprising at the time it occurs.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘48 Iranian leaders gone’: Trump claims major success as conflict with Iran escalates
item.description: US President Donald Trump announced that 48 Iranian leaders have been killed in US-Israeli strikes, describing the operation as ahead of schedule. This follows joint strikes that killed Iran's supreme leader, Ali Khamenei, prompting Iranian counterattacks across the region. The US reported three service members killed and five wounded amid escalating hostilities.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Demon of our times eliminated’: Iran’s exiled prince Raza Pahlavi on Khamenei's death
item.description: Exiled crown prince Reza Pahlavi declared the Islamic Republic nearing its end following supreme leader Khamenei's reported death in US-Israeli strikes. He warned against appointing a successor, deeming it illegitimate and urging officials to surrender power to the people. Pahlavi called for a "Lion and Sun Revolution" and appealed to armed forces to join the public's demand for regime collapse.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: America First, Diplomacy Last: The Peace President who went to war
item.description: Donald Trump, once a critic of 'endless wars,' now presides over a presidency marked by muscular interventions. His second term features forceful actions in Venezuela and Iran, alongside territorial ambitions towards Greenland. This shift from a 'peace president' to one employing high-stakes brinkmanship redefines 'America First' as forceful global reshaping, aiming for dominance rather than negotiated equilibrium.
item.dc:creator: Chidanand Rajghatta

item.title: Almost all US Military bases hit by Iran: Is America unable to safeguard its assets Middle-East?
item.description: Following the killing of Iran's Supreme Leader, Tehran launched a wide-ranging retaliatory campaign targeting US and Israeli military assets across the Middle East. Multiple Gulf nations reported missile and drone attacks, with US Central Command confirming three American service members killed. The scale of the strikes raises questions about regional air defence capabilities and potential escalation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Patriots, keep protesting’: Iranian prayer app with five million users hacked by Israel, says report
item.description: Iran's popular prayer app, BadeSaba Calendar, broadcasted anti-regime messages urging security forces to defect amid heightened unrest and foreign strikes. Screenshots circulated before a near-total internet blackout. While Israel hasn't confirmed, reports suggest this is part of its strategy to shape behavior through precise, psychologically impactful cyber operations, turning trusted tools into vulnerabilities.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 3 people, including gunman, killed; 14 injured in Texas bar shooting
item.description: A shooting at Buford's bar in Texas resulted in at least three deaths, including the alleged gunman, and 14 injuries. Police responded rapidly to the scene, engaging and killing the suspect. The swift actions of emergency services are credited with saving lives amidst the chaos.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Former Iranian president Mahmoud Ahmadinejad killed in Israeli airstrikes on Tehran: Report
item.description: Former Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad has reportedly been killed in Israeli airstrikes within Iran. Reports suggest he was under house arrest at the time of the targeted strike on his residence. Ahmadinejad, known for his hardline stance and controversial remarks, served as Iran's president from 2005 to 2013, often drawing international criticism for his rhetoric.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk
